text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "sets.mcmIdExtras stores Magic Card Market set IDs for a set's 'extras' edition (its siblings mcmId/mcmName confirm this), while foreign_data.id is a surrogate auto-increment primary key for foreign-language card printings, so the 10 small integers (2371–3680) falling inside the target's 1–229186 range is pure chance overlap, not a real reference."}
